item.title: Car obstructing pavement, 23rd August
item.description:
This car is always abandoned here, covering half the pavement. I have seen people with disabilities struggle to get past. My 94 year old aunt was unable to walk through the small gap left with her mobility aid. The road next to the car is not safe to walk on as large lorry’s going to the building site at the bottom always pass - in addition to many cars. This car is always abandoned here and not a one off thing. It is a danger for children and those with disabilities. It is on manor road next to the church yard.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Bexley High Street, Bexley, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Exposed electric box, 23rd August
item.description:
There are several electrical and gas boxes attached to side of the corner shop on Clifford Avenue, protruding into the pavement. At least one has a broken cover exposing the unit to the elements. Above it is a balcony with a broken gutter directly above the exposed unit. The guttering needs fixing and the boxes securing to prevent a serious accident - not least as young children frequent the area.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Clifford Avenue, Elmstead, Greater London
